findings.text: follow-on: the seat-release refusal reports WATCHER_LOAD_BOUND_SECONDS (the configured full bound) rather than the remaining budget handed to the child, so under contention the message names WATCHER_LOAD_BOUND_SECONDS 30s when the child only had the leftover wait, slightly mangling the diagnostic it exists to give.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit 90cb25078 against base 43181a642, three files (+320/-44): dispatch.py bounds the arm flock and moves delivery resolution outside the mutex, runs.py extracts watch_observer_alive, and the new test file adds five cases.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done-when's gate names tests/test_*watch*.py, tests/test_follow*.py, tests/test_producer*.py plus the new file; the manifest records base 43181a642 (1 failed, 249 passed, EXIT=1) and head 90cb25078 (255 passed, 1 skipped, EXIT=0) with added failures 0, and my re-run of the new file gave 5 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is "No long-lived process holds the watch arm lock"; reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1238 _ensure_watch_producer now takes the .arm.lock with LOCK_NB under a deadline at dispatch.py:1254 and releases it before resolving session delivery, and its new tests show the lock free while a producer and a follower are alive.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records commit 90cb25078, base/head gate logs with EXIT lines, a declared descriptor-leak negative control that reddened EXIT=1, changed_paths of three files, and blockers none.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares six exclusive paths (reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/watch.py, reckon/crew/runs.py, the new test file, an evidence fragment and a figures dir); the diff touch is confined to the three under reckon/ and tests/, all inside that declared set.

justifications.durability: tests/test_arm_lock_is_never_held_by_a_follower.py:188 fails on reverting the bound (arming must exit 3 within 8s) and the node's declared descriptor-leak mutation reddened test_live_producer_and_follower_leave_arm_lock_free at EXIT=1.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's logs (base.log one FAILED at EXIT=1, head.log zero FAILED at EXIT=0) match what I read at test_logs, and my independent re-run of tests/test_arm_lock_is_never_held_by_a_follower.py at head gave 5 passed EXIT=0.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/runs.py:3186 extracts the observer-liveness check already inlined at runs.py:3242 into one helper, matching the module's idiom and introducing no plan, ticket or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1254 acquires the arm lock non-blocking under the deadline at dispatch.py:1250 and dispatch.py:1268 releases it before session resolution, so the lock is held only for the bounded arming step; the historical 30-minute holder is left unattributed in the manifest.
justifications.reuse: watch_observer_alive at runs.py:3186 is shared by both its callers rather than duplicated, and no existing owner of a bounded child-unwatch exists, so dispatch.py:1201 introduces that capability rather than forking one.
justifications.scope_discipline: the 43181a642..90cb25078 delta is confined to reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/runs.py and tests/test_arm_lock_is_never_held_by_a_follower.py, every one an element of the declared write paths, with no unrelated edit.
